untertitel: Rooms and direct messages with other NAS users – share files and invite guests by link.
verbindung_weg: The chat connection was interrupted – it will reconnect shortly.
handy_erklaerung: New chat messages and calls show up on your phone when you're not in FAH-NAS. Only who wrote is shown – never the text.
handy_anleitung: Install the “ntfy” app on your phone and scan this code – or subscribe to this address there:
handy_test_ok: Test notification sent – it should appear on your phone shortly.
handy_test_nicht: The test notification could not be sent. Ask an admin to check the ntfy server under System → Notifications.
handy_laden_fehl: The setting could not be loaded.
browser_erklaerung: A browser notification while FAH-NAS is in the background. It only says who wrote – never the text.
browser_verweigert: The browser doesn't allow notifications. Allow them in the browser's site settings and try again.
dm_erklaerung: Choose who you want to write to. Only the two of you can see the conversation.
einladung_gueltig_erklaerung: After that the link stops working. Anyone who already joined stays in the room.
einladung_loeschen_frage: Delete this link? Anyone who already joined stays in the room.
einladung_max_erklaerung: Leave empty for no limit. Once the number is reached, the link stops working.
einladung_max_ungueltig: Please enter a number from 1 to 1000 or leave the field empty.
einladungen_erklaerung: Anyone with the link can join as a guest without an account. Guests only see this room and appear as “Guest” in the member list.
kopieren_selbst: Please select the link in the field and copy it yourself.
max_anhang_erklaerung: The chat rejects larger files. Applies to all rooms, users and guests.
max_anhang_ungueltig: Please enter a number from 1 to 20480 MiB.
mitglieder_erklaerung: You can add more later or invite guests by link.
nachricht_loeschen_frage: Delete this message for everyone? Attachments are deleted too.
personen_alle_da: All NAS users are already members.
personen_leer: There are no other NAS users.
qr_fehl: The QR code could not be drawn.
raeume_verwalten_erklaerung: Admins see all rooms here – without messages. Deleting removes a room with its history and attachments for everyone.
raum_beschreibung_erklaerung: Optional – shown at the top of the room.
raum_loeschen_frage: Delete room “{name}” with all messages and attachments for everyone? This cannot be undone.
raum_name_fehlt: Please give the room a name.
raum_weg: This room no longer exists or you're not a member.
speichern_erklaerung: Where on the NAS should “{name}” go?
standardordner_erklaerung: “Save to …” below an attachment stores it there. Without a default folder you choose each time or download.
standardordner_keiner: No default folder – files are downloaded.
standardordner_wahl: Only folders you can write to.
stumm_erklaerung: Muted: no sound and no notification for this room. Unread messages still count.
suchen_weg: The message could not be found anymore.
ton_erklaerung: A short sound when a message arrives and you're not looking at the room.
verlassen_frage: Leave “{name}”? You can only come back if someone adds or invites you.
waehlen: Choose a room on the left or start a conversation.
teilen_erklaerung: “{name}” is copied into the chosen room as an attachment. Choose a room or a direct message.
teilen_keine_raeume: You're not in any room yet. Create one in the chat or start a direct message.
anruf_voll: The call is full (6 at most).
anruf_ersetzt: You joined the call on another device.
anruf_entfernt: You are no longer in this room.
anruf_kein_zugriff: No access to the microphone. Allow it in the browser settings.
unterwegs_schalter_erklaerung: Helps calls across different networks, e.g. a phone on mobile data or guests on the go. At home and over VPN calls work without it.
unterwegs_port_erklaerung: The relay listens on this port. Only change it if 3478 is already in use.
unterwegs_port_fehler: Please enter a number from 1024 to 65535.
unterwegs_aus: Switched off – calls then only work at home, over VPN or when a direct connection succeeds.
unterwegs_port_belegt: Port {port} is in use – choose another one.
unterwegs_keine_ip: The NAS address on the home network is unknown.
unterwegs_erklaerung: So calls also work across different networks, FAH-NAS relays between the devices itself. Only admins see this card.
dm_geschlossen: This account no longer exists – the history stays readable.
gast_link_sperren_erklaerung: Deletes the link {name} used – nobody else can use it afterwards either. Without this, {name} can rejoin with the same link.
anruf_kein_raum: This room no longer exists – or you are not a member.
anruf_fehler: The call could not start. Please try again in a moment.
unterwegs_fehler_agent: The control service is not responding – the connection helper is therefore not running.
unterwegs_fehler_start: The connection helper could not be started (details in the web service log).
